$comment: The eight facts the reviewed entry records (ObservedPortalAuthentication), for THIS entry and no other.
Until P299 this said six were from the signed-out read of the entry page on 2026-09-11. That read settled
AUTH 1, 2, 3 and 6 for the pages it read (../sheffield-pgt-2026-09-11-entry/README.md answers each with its
evidence); it settled AUTH 8 by reasoning from AUTH 1, not by a page, and did not settle AUTH 7 (both below
and in row 169 of docs/state-of-the-system.md). Two — emailVerificationRequired and mfaOrOtpRequired — no page read could
settle; they are OBSERVED BY VAHID, NOT BY A RUN, and recorded as his direct statement of 2026-09-11:
AUTH 4: 'no verification step. I entered an email and a password on the New Applicants form, pressed Start
Application, and went straight into the form. No email had to be opened, no link clicked, nothing stood
between the button and the first page.'
AUTH 5: 'no second factor. I signed in again later with email and password only and went straight into the
form. No code arrived and none was asked for.'
AUTH 5 at sign-in was later seen by a run as well: Run A signed in to the account the reads use on every
attempt from 4 (2026-09-21) to 10 (2026-09-22) with no code asked for (docs/what-run-a-proved.md);
registration was not. (P302: that account is registered with an address that is not his,
docs/run-a/p301-his-account-as-sent.txt.)
P302, 2026-10-13, his words (docs/run-a/p302-his-decisions-as-sent.txt): 'AUTH 5: I cannot confirm the exact
words of 2026-09-11. Rebuild AUTH 5 to rest on Run A's observation alone.' So the AUTH 5 words above are
P92's record of his statement, and he cannot confirm them; in the patch for his signature AUTH 5 rests on
Run A's sign-ins alone.
The AUTH 4 words above are P92's record of the same statement. Whether his sentence covers them too is his
to say (P302).
Until P300 the type carried one discoveryRunId for the record and no per-fact provenance, so this comment
and the READMEs are where the provenance of those facts lives, and the reviewer reads them together. P300
added a source beside each fact; Sheffield's are recorded for his signature in docs/run-a/p300-for-signature.md,
and once he signs they are the sources below.
Vahid, 2026-09-11, carried with them in his words: 'this is Sheffield's behaviour, not a property of direct
portals. Another university may verify the email, or ask for a code, and finding that out is per-target work,
not something these two answers settle for anything but this entry.'
P299, 2026-10-12: AUTH 7 (passwordResetAvailable) was recorded here as true and was never observed: the
signed-out read found the reset page and sent nothing (../sheffield-pgt-2026-09-11-entry/README.md, AUTH 7).
Vahid, 2026-10-12: 'it was never observed, so it must not be recorded as true. Record it as not observed
until someone tries it.' So it was recorded "unobserved" here, and chooseApproach refused this record,
naming that one question; scripts/sheffield-draft.test.ts holds what the chooser does with the value here.
P301, 2026-10-12: Vahid tried it on the account used for the reads (docs/run-a/p301-his-auth7-as-sent.txt):
'Forgot password' works and sends no reset link; Sheffield replaces the password at once and e-mails a new
one in plain text. Recorded for his signature in docs/run-a/p300-for-signature.md: once he signs, AUTH 7 here
reads true, his words are its source, and passwordResetSends records what the reset sends. The run never
presses 'Forgot password' on any portal (P301; ADR-0020 section 5a). Row 169 holds what AUTH 3, 5, 6 and 8
rest on.
DRAFT. The reviewed entry is the one above, signed by Vahid alone.

The login form takes an email and a password, and the only other route is a reset. Pages after sign-in were not read for it.

The runner's read of the login page of 2026-09-18, run attached-sheffield-pgt-september-direct-2026-09-18T16-01-11-335Z (docs/captures/sheffield-pgt-2026-09-18-login-as-runner), signed out with tags allowed: the same forms and signals as the read of 2026-09-11.

passwordResetAvailable.words: "Forgot password" works, but it does not send a reset link. Sheffield immediately generates a new password, replacing the old one, and e-mails it in plain text to the account's e-mail address, with a recommendation to sign in and change it. I am changing it now.

credentialsCanBeHandedBack.from: AUTH 1 and the design: the password is the student's own, chosen at registration and never held by AskiMate (ADR-0020, ADR-0101), and nothing seen on the portal would prevent the student taking control (docs/captures/sheffield-pgt-2026-09-11-entry/README.md, AUTH 8: 'settled by AUTH 1, not by a page'). No account has been handed back on this portal, so nothing has observed it.
